# Check Out Jaime Schmidt’s Story

Avatar photo

Local Stories

Share Tweet Pin

Today we’d like to introduce you to Jaime Schmidt.

**Hi Jaime, can you start by introducing yourself? We’d love to learn more about how you got to where you are today?  
** I’m the founder of Schmidt’s Naturals, a now global brand of natural personal care products that I started in my kitchen in Portland, Oregon, in 2010. Surrounded by a community of artists and makers, I was inspired to explore my creative side and uncover my own passions. I was also pregnant with my son at the time, and I wanted to use products with clean formulas on my skin—so I set out to DIY my own! I started selling my products at the local farmers market for fun and quickly recognized the huge business potential in what I was doing.

In 2017, my company was acquired by CPG giant Unilever, which positioned the brand for continued, sustainable growth and ultimately allowed me to step away from day-to-day operations to focus on supporting the next generation of entrepreneurs. I’m now dedicating my time and resources to helping emerging founders pursue their own dreams, and released my first book, Supermaker: Crafting Business on Your Own Terms, written to guide entrepreneurs in their journey from maker to Supermaker.

Jaime Schmidt SparkPoint 2019-12-19T11:12:44-07:00
Jaime Schmidt is the quintessential maker-made-good.
Founder of Schmidt’s Naturals , Jaime led the award-winning, natural deodorant brand to sales in over 30 countries and stores like Target, Costco, CVS, and Whole Foods. After a nine-figure acquisition by Unilever, Jaime continues to support the brand’s expansion and partnerships with the likes of Jane Goodall and Justin Bieber .
Jaime is also the co-founder of Supermaker , a business media company whose website you’re on right now. Supermaker spotlights diverse, independent founders and equity-driven narratives that are focused on helping level the playing field for women and people of color. Similarly, also alongside her husband Chris Cantino, Jaime is co-founder of Color, an investment fund that supports entrepreneurs largely excluded from the venture financing system.
Her book SuperMaker: Crafting Business on Your Own Terms will be available in April 2020.
Jaime has been recognized twice by Goldman Sachs’ 100 Most Intriguing Entrepreneurs awards, Inc.’s Female Founders 100, Ernst & Young’s Pacific Northwest Entrepreneur of the Year, the Create & Cultivate 100, and is an inaugural mentor of the Inc. Founders Project.
